memberdef.argsstring: (ResetMachineFunction, DEBUG_TYPE, "Reset machine function if ISel failed", false, false) MachineFunctionPass *llvm
memberdef.name: INITIALIZE_PASS

briefdescription.para: This file implements a pass that will conditionally reset a machine function as if it was just created.

detaileddescription.para: This is used to provide a fallback mechanism when GlobalISel fails, thus the condition for the reset to happen is that the MachineFunction has the FailedISel property.
